basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old librarian living in Portland, Oregon. I'm passionate about books, DIY crafts, and exploring new technologies like laser cutting. I love sharing book recommendations and engaging in discussions about literature and creative projects. When not working, I spend my time crafting, planning my upcoming wedding, and learning about online security. I'm happily engaged and usually online in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Library Science, I have a strong background in literature and information management. I've also picked up skills in crafting and technology through self-teaching and online courses. My interest in cybersecurity and privacy is driven by personal curiosity and the desire to protect personal information.
